chunks: But We see it very near.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean when it says the Day of Judgment is 'near'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the relativity of time, illustrating that what seems like a long delay to humanity is instantaneous for Allah, reinforcing the concept of divine omnipotence over temporal constraints. It serves as a spiritual reassurance for the believers, encouraging patience (sabr) during the perceived waiting period for the final reckoning. This perspective aligns with the Shia understanding of the Occultation (Ghaybah) of the Imam, where the delay in justice is not an absence but a manifestation of divine wisdom and timing.
